description:
Request for Quotation for two refrigerator units used for tree seedling storage to restore full operational capability of both refrigeration systems through component replacement, diagnostics, and performance verification.  Located on the Six Rivers National Forest, Gasquet Ranger District, 10600 Hwy 199, Gasquet, CA 95543.  For more information the following documents are included as attachments to this solicitation and can be accessed via the "Attachment/Links" section of the posting.  ATTACHMENT 1 - Terms and Conditions    ATTACHMENT 2 - Schedule of Items     ATTACHMENT 3 - WD (Wage Determination) Del Norte County 15-5673.  ATTACHMENT 4 - Photos 

 Quotes are due 12/01/2026 4:30pm  Email quotes to margaret.forrest@usda/gov
